subject: Fix ULong config boundary checking (#752)
reason: The fix routes NUMERIC_TYPE_ULONG configs through the unsigned boundary-check branch of numericBoundaryCheck instead of the signed one, but no observable behavior changes on the test platform. The only ULONG configs are active-defrag-max-scan-fields (bounds 1..LONG_MAX), slowlog-max-len and acllog-max-len (bounds 0..LONG_MAX), all plain INTEGER_CONFIG parsed by string2ll, so every reachable input fits in a long long. With those bounds on 64-bit Linux, the signed (parent) and unsigned (fixed) checks accept and reject identical input sets — negatives are rejected by the signed lower-bound check
